subject.title: Feature: Opt-in cross-channel visibility in TUI (mirror iMessage/Telegram activity)

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class TUI cross-channel observe/mirror mode, and should that mode be read-only, interactive, or limited to explicitly selected sessions?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior crosses session, channel, peer, and privacy boundaries and likely adds CLI/config policy surface that automation should not choose on its own.

options.title: Read-only observe mode
options.body: Add an explicit TUI observe mode that displays authorized cross-channel activity for the selected agent without sending mirrored replies to other transports.

options.title: Interactive mirror mode
options.body: Allow bidirectional visible mirroring between TUI and channels behind stronger opt-in controls, accepting higher delivery and privacy risk.

options.title: Decline broad mirroring
options.body: Keep core limited to selected-session live updates and direct users to logs or future design for all-channel monitoring.

recommendation.title: Read-only observe mode
recommendation.body: Add an explicit TUI observe mode that displays authorized cross-channel activity for the selected agent without sending mirrored replies to other transports.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the TUI session-isolation behavior and has the strongest recent TUI session/history ownership signal.
